scene.title: Why a pendulum swings
scene.summary: A pendulum swings because gravity’s component along the arc creates a restoring torque, converting potential energy to kinetic and back.

beats.title: Pendulum at an angle
beats.narration: The bob hangs at 30° from vertical, held by tension and pulled down by gravity.

beats.title: Gravity’s component
beats.narration: Gravity can be split; the component along the swing direction (gₜₐₙ) pushes the bob toward the bottom.

beats.title: Bob accelerates down
beats.narration: The tangential component accelerates the bob, so it moves along the arc toward the lowest point.

beats.title: Swing to the other side
beats.narration: The bob climbs back up, reaching the symmetric angle on the opposite side.

beats.title: Energy exchange
beats.narration: Potential energy at the ends becomes kinetic at the bottom and back again, described by the restoring torque equation.
